chapters.reason: The paper introduces Length Controlled Policy Optimization (LCPO), which uses reinforcement learning with explicit length constraints to optimize reasoning trajectories.
The core contribution is enabling the model to adhere to user-specified length constraints, allowing for controlled allocation of test-time compute.
The paper demonstrates the ability to generate 'Short Reasoning Models' (SRMs) that produce concise reasoning paths, effectively compressing the chain-of-thought.
